items.description: The world's longest lava flow, stretching over 290 kilometers and forming a prominent ridge in the Tsavo ecosystem.
facts: Key geological feature of Tsavo East

items.description: A high-altitude plateau situated between the Aberdare Range and the Rift Valley, known for its cool climate and agriculture.
The rugged volcanic peak that forms the highest point of the Aberdares, characterized by its rocky terrain and alpine moorland.
facts: Offers views of Mount Kenya and the Rift

items.description: A small, hilly island in Lake Victoria, known for its scenic relief and as a sanctuary for diverse birdlife and impalas.
Extensive semi-arid plains in West Pokot, characterized by flat terrain and scattered acacia trees.
